verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships autonomous agentic workflows: Customer Screening and Transaction Monitoring agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate complex cases. That is a related but different feature from an in-console AI assistant. Nothing documents natural-language queries over fraud data, AI-drafted rules, or AI-generated investigation summaries, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
